name: io.github.Role1776/mcp-x
title: X (Twitter)
description: Search, read and publish X posts and manage users, lists and media via the X API v2.

environmentVariables.name: X_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 1.0a consumer key. developer.x.com -> your project -> your app -> Keys and tokens.

environmentVariables.name: X_API_KEY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 1.0a consumer secret, issued together with X_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: X_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: User access token. Set the app permissions to Read and Write BEFORE generating it: a token keeps the permissions it was created with, and a read-only one fails every write until it is regenerated.

environmentVariables.name: X_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: User access token secret, issued together with X_ACCESS_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: MEDIA_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the only directory x_media_upload may read files from. Anything outside it is refused, symlinks included.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: stdio (client spawns the process) or http (streamable HTTP listener).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Server name reported in the MCP initialize handshake.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PATH
environmentVariables.description: HTTP path the MCP endpoint is served on. Used only when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: SERVER_PORT
environmentVariables.description: TCP port to listen on. Used only when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: SERVER_READ_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP read timeout as a Go duration. Used only when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: SERVER_WRITE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP write timeout as a Go duration. Used only when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_MODE
environmentVariables.description: local (text, debug) or prod (JSON, info). Logs go to stderr.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_IDLE_CONNS_PER_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Idle connections the outbound HTTP client keeps per host.

environmentVariables.name: X_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Log the raw requests sent to the X API. Verbose; the output can contain request details, so keep it off outside debugging.

environmentVariables.name: POSTS_MAX_QUERIES
environmentVariables.description: Queries accepted in one x_posts_search or x_posts_count call.

environmentVariables.name: POSTS_MAX_USERNAMES
environmentVariables.description: Usernames accepted in one x_posts_by_user call.

environmentVariables.name: POSTS_MAX_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Post ids accepted in one x_posts_lookup call. The X API caps this at 100.

environmentVariables.name: POSTS_DEFAULT_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Posts returned per query when the call does not ask for a count. Every post returned is billed.

environmentVariables.name: POSTS_MAX_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Upper bound for posts per query. The X API caps this at 100.

environmentVariables.name: POSTS_DEFAULT_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: How far back post searches look when the call does not say, in days.

environmentVariables.name: POSTS_MAX_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Furthest back a post search may look, in days. Recent search cannot exceed 7.

environmentVariables.name: POSTS_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout for a posts call in milliseconds when the call does not request one.

environmentVariables.name: POSTS_MIN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Lowest timeout a posts call may request, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: POSTS_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Highest timeout a posts call may request, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: USERS_MAX_USERNAMES
environmentVariables.description: Usernames accepted in one x_users_lookup call. The X API caps this at 100.

environmentVariables.name: USERS_MAX_IDS
environmentVariables.description: User ids accepted in one x_users_lookup call. The X API caps this at 100.

environmentVariables.name: USERS_DEFAULT_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Users returned per page when the call does not ask for a count.

environmentVariables.name: USERS_MAX_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Upper bound for users per page.

environmentVariables.name: USERS_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout for a users call in milliseconds when the call does not request one.

environmentVariables.name: USERS_MIN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Lowest timeout a users call may request, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: USERS_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Highest timeout a users call may request, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: LISTS_DEFAULT_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Items returned per list page when the call does not ask for a count.

environmentVariables.name: LISTS_MAX_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Upper bound for items per list page. The X API caps this at 100.

environmentVariables.name: LISTS_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout for a lists call in milliseconds when the call does not request one.

environmentVariables.name: LISTS_MIN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Lowest timeout a lists call may request, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: LISTS_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Highest timeout a lists call may request, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: MEDIA_CHUNK_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Bytes per upload segment. The X APPEND endpoint caps a segment at 5 MB.

environmentVariables.name: MEDIA_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: How often the upload status is polled while X transcodes a video, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: MEDIA_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout for a whole upload in milliseconds when the call does not request one.

environmentVariables.name: MEDIA_MIN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Lowest timeout an upload may request, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: MEDIA_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Highest timeout an upload may request, in milliseconds.
